problem_statement: Return the sum of the decimal digits of n. n is a non-negative integer (excluding bool). For n = 0 return 0.
valid_input_domain: Return the sum of the decimal digits of n. n is a non-negative integer (excluding bool). For n = 0 return 0.
bug_explanation: The faulty solution uses while n > 1 instead of while n > 0, so the loop exits before processing the final digit when it equals 1.
